rounds.notes:
I prefer to open with a boost to [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) to give Suzu a nice early buff before we commit to [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) a little later in the build. We're starting with [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) and [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418). 

Take [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) against  [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power).
Take [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) against [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).

## **Playstyle:**
This build requires you to be a reactionary and defensive Support. This early, however, you're going to play as a normal Kiriko. You're not able to shut down plays at this stage so be mindful of your cooldowns, help with heals. Use your Suzu when an ally or yourself get below half health, or save it to cancel [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54) burn or [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1) wounds.

round_upgrades.notes: An easy pick for an opening power! Gives you double the chances to save an otherwise dead ally or stop those pesky DOT abilities that widdle away at y'all.

## **$10,000**
Buy [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and  [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f).

## **Under $10,000**
Keep [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), and buy [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and/or as many [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) or Survival greens as you can afford.

rounds.notes:
Take [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) to give yourself an edge against some of the more aggressive enemy heroes you may come across, and give yourself some more self-defensive opportunities.

Sell [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and...

## **$15,000**
Buy [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) as well as any [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) Green item you can afford with the remaining cash.

## **Under $15,000**
Keep [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and buy [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and either [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) or one of the Survival items from Round 1. 

## **Playstyle:**
Now with your explosive Kunai, you can afford to be a bit more aggressive. You're not a 3rd DPS, nor will you be at any point in this build, but you can make sure the enemy team don't see you as a weak Support that won't fight back. Time your reloads so you're maximizing the explosion damage to the best of your ability, and keep using Suzu as explained in Round 1.

## **$20,000**
Buy [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242), as it works really well when you're bouncing between healing your team and putting in those first few shots from [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657).

## **Under $20,000**
Keep items as is, or try to catch up on items you've missed from previous rounds.

If you're struggling to survive, sell  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) and take one of the two sets of Survival items below.
- Against [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) builds take [Vishkar Condensor](item_086a91da-b65d-4047-8fc7-28a992078b1d) and [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214).
- Against [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) builds take [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) and [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) .

## **$36,000**
- [Triple Threat](item_fc0e3d9a-5315-41c2-9aa4-331becace714): Buy [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) and, if you can afford it, [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f). You need that cooldown reduction to maximize the output of [Triple Threat](item_fc0e3d9a-5315-41c2-9aa4-331becace714), and of course you can never go wrong with more [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power).
- [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198): Buy [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40) and [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f).

## **Under $36,000***
Only buy [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f), as well as any recommended items from the previous rounds.

**Playstyle:**
- [Triple Threat](item_fc0e3d9a-5315-41c2-9aa4-331becace714): Now that we have more combat potential, you can afford to focus a bit more on using your Kunai. Triple Threat puts the first three Kunai affected by Foxy Fireworks into one wide explosive shot, good for doing a lot of burst damage and potentially scaring away a diving enemy.
If your support needs help with healing then absolutely prioritize healing first. Once again, this build is meant to enable defensive and reactive plays. You're not going for elims, you're going for pressuring the aggressive and flanking heroes away from you and your backline.
- [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198): Continue as stated in Round 5's notes. Your focus should be on keeping your team alive with healing instead of throwing Kunai, though you shouldn't forget their utility by this stage.

round_upgrades.notes: Take this power if your team is struggling to stay alive and needs help being enabled in a fight.

## **$42,000**
- [Triple Threat](item_fc0e3d9a-5315-41c2-9aa4-331becace714): Buy [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) and swap out [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) for [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56). These pair really well with this power and helps keep your team healed so you can focus more on using your Kunai. Also, [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) go brrr.
- [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198): Buy [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) to maximize your healing output.

## **Under $42,000**
Keep [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f), or replace it with one of the Blue Survival items.

rounds.notes:
The final power is truly up to your personal preference, but I prefer [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3), even after the nerfs, because it is still one of my favorite late game powers. It distracts, auto-aims, and focuses healing so you can utilize your explosive Kunai fan. It also counts towards the damage needed to trigger [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242), and overall just adds another utility for your Swift Step.

Sell [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) and...

## **$52,000**
Buy  [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) and either [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) or [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124), whichever was not picked up in Round 6.

## **Under $52,000**
Do what you can to catch up to any items missed, prioritizing the Core Items. All else fails, go into [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) as much as you can, and keep your focus on healing your team.

**Playstyle:**
You've made it to the endgame. Both teams have fought hard and now you just have to win. Use your cooldowns when you can, being careful to manage them so you aren't without Suzu or Swift Step for too long. Use your Kunai to pressure enemies and assist your team in securing elims, but be ready to switch over to heals when your other Support needs the help. Use Swift Step to rush in and add not just one, but two extra bodies to a fight with your Clone, and use Suzu to keep your teammates alive and protected.

Good luck!
